The Sect-Inn is an in-game location.

A place for rowdy and rebellious bugs of all kinds. This Inn is a building in the shape of a lamp shade, the interior a centrally planned creation, with a big, ring-like table that wraps around the main attraction, the Light Bulb in the center. This restaurant is a popular place for various insect-like creatures to gather, as there are very few other visitors; here, they are free from most discrimination that they are usually subject to in other Otti districts. 

Rumor is, this very place is the main spot where a small, bug-like paramilitary sect holds their meetings and initiations. This group is rumored to be… The Inn-Sect. Wow. There is another rumor. One of the neighbours next to this Inn spread hearsay that he has borne witness to their initiation ritual, consisting of a fabled riddle.
